question: Yumlembam Gambhini Devi was awarded the Padma Shri for which art form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manipuri** is a classical dance form originating from the Indian state of** Manipur.**
 
• It is known for its** graceful movements, fluidity**, and use of **hand gestures.**
 
• **Yumlembam Gambhini Devi** is a renowned Manipuri dancer who has received **numerous accolades** for her contribution to the art form.
 
• Yumlembam Gambhini Devi was awarded the** Padma Shri **for Manipuri dance form.
 
• Padma Shri is one of the highest civilian awards in India, and Yumlembam Gambhini Devi was awarded this honor in** 2018** for her outstanding work in the field of Manipuri dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lavani** is a popular folk dance form from the state of **Maharashtra.**

 
 
• It is known for its **energetic and sensual** movements.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance-drama form from the state of **Kerala.**
 
 
• It combines dance, music, and acting to tell stories from **Hindu mythology.**
 
 
 
• **Kathak** is another classical dance form from **northern India.**
 
 
• It is known for its intricate **footwork and fast-paced** movements.
